standard.summary: DataLoader 预取的 batch 数量。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: How many batches the DataLoader prefetches.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: DataLoader 预取的 batch 数量。默认 2 是经过测试的最佳值（平衡内存与吞吐）。增大可减少 GPU 等待数据的时间，但会占用更多内存。

advanced_en.principle: Number of batches the DataLoader prefetches. The default 2 is the tested optimum (balancing memory and throughput). Increasing it reduces GPU waiting time for data but uses more memory.
